_comment: Drake Python code validation rules and best practices

common_additional_imports.math: from pydrake.math import RigidTransform, RotationMatrix, RollPitchYaw

import_requirements.numpy: import numpy as np  # Almost always needed

correct_order: 8. plant.Finalize()  # CRITICAL: Must be before visualization

critical_points.finalize_once: plant.Finalize() can only be called once
critical_points.build_last: diagram = builder.Build() must be last step

plant_already_finalized.cause: Trying to add bodies/joints/geometries after plant.Finalize()
plant_already_finalized.fix: Move all plant modifications (AddRigidBody, WeldFrames, RegisterCollisionGeometry) BEFORE Finalize()
plant_already_finalized.code_example:
# WRONG:
plant.Finalize()
plant.WeldFrames(...)  # Error!

# CORRECT:
plant.WeldFrames(...)
plant.Finalize()

time_step_zero_error.error_message: ValueError: time_step must be positive for discrete systems
time_step_zero_error.cause: Using time_step=0.0 when discrete system is required
time_step_zero_error.when_zero_ok: time_step=0.0 is valid for continuous systems without actuation

port_connection_error.check: Ensure all required ports are connected before builder.Build()

context_mismatch.error_message: RuntimeError: Context does not belong to this system
context_mismatch.cause: Using context from one system with another system
context_mismatch.fix: Create context from the correct system: context = system.CreateDefaultContext()

file_not_found.error_message: File not found or invalid URDF/SDF
file_not_found.fix: Use os.path.abspath() for file:// URLs or check path validity

missing_base_weld.cause: Base link not welded to world

simulation_explosion.symptom: Robot parts fly apart, NaN values, simulation crashes

values.0.0: Run as fast as possible (no real-time constraint)

recording.purpose: Enables timeline scrubbing in Meshcat viewer

time_step_selection.guideline: Smaller time step = more accurate but slower

error_handling.check_ik: Always check if IK result.is_success() before using solution
error_handling.validate_inputs: Check array dimensions before setting states

pd_controller.gains: Tune Kp and Kd per joint based on inertia and task

save_diagram.code:
svg_data = diagram.GetGraphvizString(max_depth=2)
import pydot
graph = pydot.graph_from_dot_data(svg_data)[0]
graph.write_png('diagram.png')

collision_geometries.tip: Use primitive shapes (spheres, cylinders) instead of meshes when possible

time_step.tip: Use largest time_step that maintains stability

contact_models.when_to_use: Hydroelastic for deformable objects, point for rigid

debugging_checklist: ✓ Base link welded if robot should be fixed
✓ Check for error messages in console
